letter:
My dearest Liza, jaan, my endless cutie,  
Each sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Today, as the calendar flips to a new day, I feel the same flutter I did on 23 Feb 2025, only deeper. Your laughter fills my heart across continents, and your love anchors me wherever we are. Thank you for being my compass, my confidante, my forever adventure. I love you more with every sunrise and every starry night.
poem:
From desert dunes to Gujarat’s rain,  
Your smile erases every strain.  
Hand in hand, we chase the skies,  
Together, love, our spirit flies.
